Shard Guardian.name: The Shard Guardian
Shard Guardian.title: Corrupted Spirit of the Whispering Woods
Shard Guardian.intro: At the heart of the grove, a figure of bark and thorn kneels before a pulsing green light. Once she tended these woods. Now her eyes weep black sap, and the trees lean in to listen as she rises.
Shard Guardian.enrage_text: The Shard Guardian shrieks — the shard's light floods her veins and the whole grove thrashes in fury!
Shard Guardian.defeat_text: The corruption drains from the dryad's eyes. "Thank you," she whispers, as bark crumbles to green leaves. Where she fell lies a fragment of the Crown, warm as spring sunlight.

start: The grove does not want you here. Neither do I.
hurt: You cut what you do not understand!

Corrupted Captain.name: Captain Aldric the Unresting
Corrupted Captain.title: Corrupted Captain of the Watch
Corrupted Captain.intro: A figure in corroded plate stands at the dead beacon, staring east. "Report," it rasps without turning. "...No. You are not my relief. Thirty years, and still no relief." The greatsword scrapes free of its scabbard.
Corrupted Captain.enrage_text: The Captain's helm splits, pale fire pouring from within. "THE TOWER DOES NOT FALL!"
Corrupted Captain.defeat_text: The Captain sinks to one knee. "Watch... ended. At last." His armor collapses, empty. In his gauntlet is a dispatch sealed in black wax — orders bearing the sigil of someone named Malachar, and a map of four roads leading out of the valley.

attack: For a kingdom that forgot us!

Lady Vex.name: Lady Vex
Lady Vex.title: Malachar's Shadow
Lady Vex.intro: The road ahead darkens though the sun is high. A woman in a coat the color of midnight steps out of your own shadow, rapier already drawn. "Two shards. You've been busy. My master would like them back — and I would like to see what all the fuss is about."
Lady Vex.enrage_text: Lady Vex wipes blood from her lip and smiles for the first time. "Oh, you're actually dangerous. Good."
Lady Vex.defeat_text: Vex staggers back, clutching her side, and laughs. "Keep them, then. Carry them all the way to the Convergence for us." She folds into her own shadow and is gone. You have not seen the last of her.

start: Do try to make this interesting.
attack: Is that all the hero of Rivermeet has?

Flame Cultist Leader.name: High Flamecaller Ssarak
Flame Cultist Leader.title: Priest of the Salamander Cult
Flame Cultist Leader.intro: Around the lava pool the cultists fall silent. Their priest — scaled, crowned in cinders — lifts a glowing red shard from the molten rock with his bare hand. "The mountain hungers, warm-blood. You will do."
Flame Cultist Leader.enrage_text: Ssarak plunges his arm into the lava and rises wreathed in fire. "BURN WITH ME!"
Flame Cultist Leader.defeat_text: Ssarak topples backward into the pool, and the mountain's angry glow dims to embers. The fire shard rests on the temple floor, no longer scalding to the touch.

hurt: The fire does not fear you!

Corrupted High Priest.name: High Priest Oren
Corrupted High Priest.title: Drowned Voice of Dariel
Corrupted High Priest.intro: Waist-deep in black water, a priest in barnacled vestments sings to a shard that pulses like a heartbeat. He turns, and seawater pours from his smiling mouth. "Dariel was silent for so long. The shard answers every prayer."
Corrupted High Priest.enrage_text: The sanctum floods to the pillars as Oren rises on a column of dark water. "KNEEL BEFORE THE DEEP!"
Corrupted High Priest.defeat_text: The water drains away through cracks in the old stone. Oren, an old man once more, lies still upon the altar steps, his face finally at peace. The water shard is cool and calm in your hand.

Ancient Wind Rider.name: Khal Toruun, the First Rider
Ancient Wind Rider.title: Ancient Wind Rider
Ancient Wind Rider.intro: The Great Mound splits. Out of it rides a warrior of wind and bone on a horse made of storm, a shard of pale sky bound to his brow. He levels his lance at you — not in malice, but in challenge. The plains have always tested those who would carry their treasures.
Ancient Wind Rider.enrage_text: The First Rider throws back his head and the sky answers — the storm descends to ride beside him!
Ancient Wind Rider.defeat_text: Khal Toruun dismounts, salutes you with his lance across his chest, and scatters into a warm wind that bends the grass for miles. The air shard drifts down into your open hand.

hurt: The plains will sing of this!

Primordial Earth Elemental.name: Ghorrum, the Mountain's Heart
Primordial Earth Elemental.title: Primordial Earth Elemental
Primordial Earth Elemental.intro: The chamber wall opens two eyes of molten amber. What you took for the cavern itself unfolds — shoulders of granite, a chest of raw crystal with the earth shard beating inside it like a heart. It does not speak. Mountains do not need to.
Primordial Earth Elemental.enrage_text: Cracks race across Ghorrum's body and blaze with inner light — the whole cavern begins to come down!
Primordial Earth Elemental.defeat_text: Ghorrum settles slowly back into the wall, becoming stone, becoming mountain, becoming still. The earth shard rolls gently to your feet. All the shards you carry hum together, one chord short of complete.

Lady Vex (Final Battle).name: Lady Vex, Unbound
Lady Vex (Final Battle).title: Shadow Sorceress of the Convergence
Lady Vex (Final Battle).intro: Lady Vex lounges sideways on a throne that is not hers. "You carried them all the way here. I did say you would." She stands, and every shadow in the hall stands with her. "No running this time. For either of us."
Lady Vex (Final Battle).enrage_text: Vex's form unravels at the edges into pure shadow. "I gave him everything. I will NOT lose to you!"
Lady Vex (Final Battle).defeat_text: Vex falls against the throne, her shadows guttering out like candles. "He promised me... a world without masters." She looks toward the ritual chamber. "The seal on his door was mine. It dies with me. Go — ruin his day."

hurt: Is that fear, or is it me?

Malachar the Void-touched.name: Malachar the Void-touched
Malachar the Void-touched.title: Sorcerer of the Shattered Crown
Malachar the Void-touched.locked_text: A seal of living shadow bars the chamber door, woven in Lady Vex's hand. While she lives, none may enter.
Malachar the Void-touched.intro: The Convergence Chamber has no ceiling — only a wound in the sky where another world presses through. Malachar floats at its center, half man and half absence. "The Crown kept five provinces in polite chains," he says, almost kindly. "I am offering them infinity. Give me the shards, and watch."
Malachar the Void-touched.enrage_text: Malachar's body tears open like paper, the void behind it screaming. "THEN BE UNMADE WITH EVERYTHING ELSE!"
Malachar the Void-touched.defeat_text: The shards in your pack blaze and leap free, circling Malachar faster and faster — and close. The Crown of Unity, whole once more, falls ringing to the floor. Above, the wound in the sky heals like a held breath released. Malachar is simply gone.

start: You stand at the end of the world. Try to appreciate it.
attack: The void is patient. I am not.
